name: Sunsama
all_locations: Kailua, HI, USA; Oakland, CA, USA; Remote
long_description:
Sunsama organizes your work one day at a time.

In the morning, plan your day. Pick out what you want to work on today by importing your tasks and meetings for the day from your various tools. Decide how much time you want to spend on each item to make sure you're setting realistic goals for yourself.

As the day goes on, stay focused. Concentrate on one task at a time. Keep track of how long you've been working, and when it's time to shift your attention to something else.

When you're done, shut down for the day. Reflect on what you were able to accomplish. End the day feeling satisfied with what you could do rather than consumed by what you couldn't.

Sunsama is built to improve your relationship with your work. Work should be an engine for fulfillment, not for stress and anxiety.

name: Humance
long_description:
Humance is building an AI-powered project management tool for the construction industry, where work is highly coordinated and delays are costly.

Large projects involve dozens of interdependent workstreams where a single setback can cascade unpredictably through the entire timeline. Today, most project managers track this manually — tracing dependencies by hand, updating schedules, and notifying stakeholders one by one. It's slow, error-prone, and pulls focus away from the higher-order decisions that demand real expertise.

Experienced project managers carry deep knowledge — of sequencing, trade-offs, site realities, and stakeholder dynamics — that no tool can replicate. Humance is built around that expertise. By handling the mechanical work of dependency tracking and schedule coordination, it frees project managers to do what they're actually skilled at: exercising judgment, managing complexity, and keeping the big picture in view.
one_liner: AI that keeps complex construction projects on schedule.

name: BiggerPicture
long_description:
BiggerPicture, Inc. runs the largest freight scheduling network in the industry.

It is a freight appointment network. Carriers, shippers, and facilities work from one shared shipment record, so the appointment a carrier requests is the same appointment the facility confirms and the shipper sees. Nothing to reconcile between systems, no email threads to chase.

One workspace covers every scheduling channel: email, bulk email, and direct portal integrations. Automation handles routine booking and routes anything that needs a human into an exception queue. Every party is graded on one shared, published compliance standard rather than each provider's own unpublished metrics.

Some of the largest brokers and carriers in the country run on our network. SOC 2 Type II. Women-led.
one_liner: The largest freight scheduling network in the industry.

founders.title: Founder

During that time, she felt the acute challenges of siloed technology and workflows across the supply chain resulted in less than 1% of shipments could be handled without human intervention, which propelled her to found BiggerPicture.

name: Foreman
long_description:
Foreman is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built for construction contractors and the trade industry.
Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops.
Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice. Contractors upload plans, photos, or a project description, and Foreman's AI instantly generates structured takeoffs, scoped estimates, and professional proposals — in minutes, not hours. From there, every customer record, document, permit, photo, change order, and conversation lives in one place, organized around the job.
The result: contractors spend less time buried in admin and more time building. They bid faster, manage jobs with less chaos, and close projects cleanly — without duct-taping five tools together to do it.
one_liner: Keeping contractors on the job site, not behind a desk.

Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)\
I’m [Nolan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/), founder of [**Scout Out**](https://www.scoutout.ai).

**TL;DR**

Residential contractors juggle dozens of moving pieces — estimates, plans, takeoffs, proposals, change orders, documents — across spreadsheets, email threads, and sticky notes. Scout Out is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built specifically for construction, automating the busywork so contractors can focus on building.

[**Scout Out**](https://scoutout.ai/) contractors one platform to manage every job — with AI that handles takeoffs, clients, crew, and documents in minutes, not hours.\
\
**Ask:** If you know residential contractors, remodelers, or builders drowning in admin work, we'd love an intro.

👉 Contact us at: [nolan@scoutout.ai](mailto:nolan@scoutout.ai)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/30e770cd-ac0d-4853-9d5c-40b1cb0f9615)

# [**🕺**](https://emojipedia.org/man-dancing)**The Team**

[**Nolan (Founder & CEO)**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/) – triple majored in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Astrophysics, and Business Administration through UC Berkeley’s M.E.T. program, graduating in three years. He previously worked as a software development engineer at Amazon and ran a software consultancy he scaled to $250k in revenue. As a fourth-generation member of a family construction business, Nolan saw firsthand how difficult it is for contractors to consistently find new work — and how little time they have to sit down and bid on projects while managing active jobs. Scout Out was built to solve that problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/6d9cfed3-6baf-4fac-b9b7-ec2a2d99a6de)

# **❌ The Problem**

Residential contractors are running complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never built for construction.

* **Project management is fragmented.** Plans live in email. Estimates live in spreadsheets. Photos live on phones. Proposals get copy-pasted from old Word docs. Nothing talks to anything else.
* **Estimating is slow and error-prone.** Reading through plans, measuring takeoffs, pricing labor and materials, then assembling a professional proposal — this process takes hours and still produces mistakes. Contractors either underbid to win, or overbid to be safe, and lose anyway.
* **AI tools exist but aren't built for construction.** Generic project management software ignores the realities of field work — plan sets, per-page takeoffs, scope changes mid-build, subcontractor coordination.

  Contractors end up duct-taping tools together and paying the price in margin and stress.

**The result:** Jobs are won with incomplete bids, managed with ad-hoc systems, and closed with manual paperwork that eats hours contractors don't have.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/0cdecb42-5772-4e1d-81d1-1d7fb87db86d)

# **🙌 Our Solution: One Platform for the Entire Job**

Scout Out is a single platform that handles the full lifecycle of a construction job — from first estimate to final invoice — with AI doing the heavy lifting.

### Job & Customer Hub 🏗️

Everything lives in one place, organized around the job:

* Customer records and full contact history
* All uploads in one place: plans, photos, permits, contracts, and insurance
* Status tracking across every deliverable and milestone
* Every conversation, change order, and document tied to the right job

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/ffbb3afc-3a3e-425d-800a-23c7fc95413a)

### Instant AI-Powered Bidding ⚡

When a contractor finds a project they want, ScoutOut generates a **clean, editable quote in seconds**.

* Upload plans, photos, or a short description
* AI produces a structured estimate covering scope, labor, and materials
* Contractors can review, adjust, and send a professional bid immediately

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/cf8c8b3c-0744-4b8b-b092-16e0952bf102)

### Built for Real Contractor Workflows 🔧

ScoutOut is designed for how contractors actually work:

* No long setup or training
* Quotes are editable and contractor-owned
* Built to be used between site visits, calls, and active builds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/f723d694-6721-4b5a-a80a-4bd39e691892)
